# The provided sample shows the string in column A split horizontally starting in column D.
# Fill only the specified answer range D5:K7, using the string on the same row in column A.
start_row, end_row = 5, 7
start_col, end_col = 4, 11  # D:K
source_col = 1             # A

for r in range(start_row, end_row + 1):
    source = ws.cell(row=r, column=source_col).value
    text = "" if source is None else str(source)
    for c in range(start_col, end_col + 1):
        idx = c - start_col
        cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=c)
        if idx < len(text):
            cell.value = text[idx]
        else:
            # No corresponding character; leave/restore as blank rather than writing 0 or placeholder.
            cell.value = None

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"saved to {output_path}")
